title: mentha × piperita var. balsamea
intro: Mentha × piperita var. balsamea, commonly known as Peppermint Balsam, is a natural variation of peppermint that is native to North America. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including the potential to alleviate digestive issues, headaches, and respiratory problems, due to its ability to reduce inflammation and relax the muscles. The therapeutic actions of Peppermint Balsam are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as menthol, menthone, and limonene, which exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of Peppermint Balsam work together to provide relief from pain, itching, and irritation, making it a popular natural remedy for various health concerns.
